Direct inspection of fusion.ml found the complete HOL kernel interface and implementation: type/term syntax, theorem type, primitive inference rules, axioms, and definitional extension mechanisms.

Direct inspection of UnitTests/basic_tests.ml found formal term equalities, conversions, inductive definitions, and proof scripts exercising theorem-prover semantics; tests therefore carry useful formal/API evidence rather than forming a demonstrably disposable path class.

The 680 primary ML files span core logic, tactics, theorem libraries, examples, formalized mathematics, proof-recording/model tooling, and regression specimens. No broad path-based exclusion is lossless at unit scope, so the full formal-source set is retained.

summary: Both files contain formal mathematical content relevant to search. preterm.ml implements the core typechecking and quotation translation machinery that converts surface syntax into formal HOL terms, including type unification, overload resolution, and term construction. UnitTests/parser_tests.ml exercises this machinery with concrete formal mathematical expressions (quantifiers, lambda abstractions, type annotations, overloaded operators) and asserts their expected typing behavior. Neither file is a pure import aggregator; both contain executable formal code central to HOL Light's mathematical interface.
